changelog:
- Added session-based User-Agent flag with {session-id} template to all API-invoking commands for unified observability and traceability.
- Deprecated use of `aliyun configure ai-mode` for User-Agent; now all `--user-agent` flags must be passed explicitly per command.
- Updated installation and usage instructions in SKILL.md to reflect new User-Agent and session tracking requirements.
- Expanded observability guidance, including session-id generation and export rules.
- Removed obsolete helper steps and documentation (e.g., skill-card.md, deprecated ai-mode instructions).
summary: Alibaba Cloud PAI-DLC (Deep Learning Containers) job management skill. Covers: distributed training job CRUD, monitoring (logs and events), and GPU sanity check. Triggers: "DLC", "PAI-DLC", "create-job", "list-jobs", "get-job", "stop-job", "update-job", "get-pod-logs", "get-job-events", "get-pod-events", "list-job-sanity-check-results".
